questions.q:
Simplify to a single trigonometric ratio:
[cos(180° − x) · sin(x − 90°) · tan(180° + x)] / [sin(90° + x) · cos(360° − x)]
points: = [(−cos x)(−cos x)(tan x)] / [(cos x)(cos x)] (one mark per reduction)
questions.qAf:
Vereenvoudig tot ’n enkele trigonometriese verhouding:
[cos(180° − x) · sin(x − 90°) · tan(180° + x)] / [sin(90° + x) · cos(360° − x)]
pointsAf: = [(−cos x)(−cos x)(tan x)] / [(cos x)(cos x)] (een punt per reduksie)

questions.q: Determine the value of cos 75° · cos 15° without using a calculator.
questions.qAf: Bepaal die waarde van cos 75° · cos 15° sonder om ’n sakrekenaar te gebruik.

questions.q: Prove the identity: sin 2x / (1 + cos 2x) = tan x
points: = 2 sin x cos x / (2cos²x) = sin x / cos x = tan x = RHS
questions.qAf: Bewys die identiteit: sin 2x / (1 + cos 2x) = tan x
pointsAf: = 2 sin x cos x / (2cos²x) = sin x / cos x = tan x = RK

points: g: shape intercepts (0° ; 0), (180° ; 0) and end point (−90° ; 1)
questions.qAf: Skets die grafieke van f(x) = cos 2x en g(x) = −sin x op dieselfde assestelsel vir x ∈ [−90° ; 180°]. Toon die afsnitte met die asse en die eindpunte aan.

questions.q: Use your graphs and your answer to 7.1 to find the values of x in [−90° ; 180°] for which f(x) ≥ g(x).
points: The graphs meet at x = −30° and x = 90°
−30° ≤ x ≤ 180° (f touches g at 90°, so the inequality still holds there)
questions.qAf: Gebruik jou grafieke en jou antwoord op 7.1 om die waardes van x in [−90° ; 180°] te vind waarvoor f(x) ≥ g(x).
pointsAf: Die grafieke ontmoet by x = −30° en x = 90°
−30° ≤ x ≤ 180° (f raak g by 90°, dus geld die ongelykheid steeds daar)

sections.title: Trigonometry in 2D and 3D
sections.intro: PQ is a vertical tower of height h. R and S lie in the same horizontal plane as Q, the foot of the tower. RS = d, ∠QRS = β and ∠QSR = θ. The angle of elevation of P from R is α.
sections.introAf: PQ is ’n vertikale toring met hoogte h. R en S lê in dieselfde horisontale vlak as Q, die voet van die toring. RS = d, ∠QRS = β en ∠QSR = θ. Die hoogtehoek van P vanaf R is α.

questions.q: Show that QR = d · sin θ / sin(β + θ).
points: QR / sin θ = d / sin[180° − (β + θ)] (sine rule)
QR = d sin θ / sin(β + θ)
questions.qAf: Toon aan dat QR = d · sin θ / sin(β + θ).
pointsAf: QR / sin θ = d / sin[180° − (β + θ)] (sinusreël)
QR = d sin θ / sin(β + θ)

questions.q: Hence show that h = d · sin θ · tan α / sin(β + θ).
points: h = QR tan α = d sin θ tan α / sin(β + θ)
questions.qAf: Toon daarna aan dat h = d · sin θ · tan α / sin(β + θ).

points: Construction: draw RO and produce it to S

questions.qAf: In die diagram is O die middelpunt van die sirkel en P, Q en R lê op die sirkel. Bewys die stelling wat sê dat ∠POQ = 2∠PRQ.

OP = OR (radiusse), dus ∠OPR = ∠ORP (∠e teenoor gelyke sye)
∠POS = ∠OPR + ∠ORP (buite-∠ van △) = 2∠ORP
